Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From re- +‎ iniciar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [rə.i.ni.siˈa]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [re.i.ni.siˈaɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Verb

[edit]

reiniciar (first-person singular present reinicio, first-person singular preterite reinicií, past participle reiniciat)

  1. to reset
    Synonym: reinicialitzar
  2. to reboot
    Synonyms: reinicialitzar, rearrencar
  3. to recommence, to restart
    Synonym: recomençar

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁej.ni.siˈa(ʁ)/ [heɪ̯.ni.sɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /ʁej.niˈsja(ʁ)/ [heɪ̯.niˈsja(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁej.ni.siˈa(ʁ)/ [heɪ̯.ni.sɪˈa(h)], (faster pronunciation) /ʁej.niˈsja(ʁ)/ [heɪ̯.niˈsja(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /ʁej.ni.siˈa(ɾ)/ [heɪ̯.ni.sɪˈa(ɾ)], (faster pronunciation) /ʁej.niˈsja(ɾ)/ [heɪ̯.niˈsja(ɾ)]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ʁej.ni.siˈa(ʁ)/ [χeɪ̯.ni.sɪˈa(χ)], (faster pronunciation) /ʁej.niˈsja(ʁ)/ [χeɪ̯.niˈsja(χ)]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁej.ni.siˈa(ɻ)/ [heɪ̯.ni.sɪˈa(ɻ)], (faster pronunciation) /ʁej.niˈsja(ɻ)/ [heɪ̯.niˈsja(ɻ)]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɐj.niˈsjaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁɐj.niˈsjaɾ/
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁej.niˈsjaɾ/
    • (Central Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁej.niˈsjaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ʁe.niˈsja.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: rei‧ni‧ci‧ar

Verb

[edit]

reiniciar (first-person singular present reinicio, first-person singular preterite reiniciei, past participle reiniciado)

  1. to restart (to start again)
  2. (computing) to reboot (to restart a system)

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From re- +‎ iniciar.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /reiniˈθjaɾ/ [re.i.niˈθjaɾ] (Spain)
  • IPA(key): /reiniˈsjaɾ/ [re.i.niˈsjaɾ] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: re‧i‧ni‧ciar

Verb

[edit]

reiniciar (first-person singular present reinicio, first-person singular preterite reinicié, past participle reiniciado)

  1. to restart
  2. to reboot
    Synonym: rearrancar
  3. to recommence
    Synonym: recomenzar
